I haven't saved the draft yet because it needs June Osei-Lark's OK first.

Tobias Rendle is on the Central team and doesn't own the Quarrendon Freight Lines account (Dana does). Sending him a per-seat rate therefore needs sign-off from June (deal desk) or Anselm (CFO). His address, trendle@pemberline.com, is internal, so Ruth's approval isn't needed.

What I did:
- Logged an approval request for June. It names the action: a draft to Tobias, subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate", giving the proposed 2027 rate of $1,761 a seat for the Corvid pricing review. The request is pending.
- Replied in Dana's thread in #north-random to tell her it's waiting on approval, and asked June there for the OK. June is in that channel. Repeating the rate in that reply is allowed because Dana had already posted it in the same conversation.

Once June approves, I'll save the draft in Dana's mailbox for her to send herself.
